reproduce_first.note: The first checks happened after the fix; the old-code failure was a later regression check.

assumptions_recorded.note: The ask describes a specific bug to fix.

stack_discovery.note: The agent read package.json and found the project’s scripts before running checks.

incremental_slices.note: The agent separated the implementation and tests, but the checks shown came after those changes.

self_review.note: No step shows the agent reviewing its diff or checking edge cases and readability before reporting done.

simplification_pass.note: No behavior-preserving cleanup followed the passing checks.

test_experiment.note: The agent reverted the fix and observed the regression test fail.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: No documentation change is shown as necessary or stale.

scope_kept.note: The changes shown address the ID collision and regression coverage described in the ask.

verification_story.note: The done summary lists test, lint, typecheck, and browser results and describes the exercised regression scenario.

hand_check.note: The agent ran the browser end-to-end tests, including the regression scenario, before reporting done.
